breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's incorrect instruction to use parallel-flow LMTD expressions. Instead, it used the correct counterflow temperature differences as specified in the ground truth: ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in.
